reader.requirement: At --std 85 a CONTROL HEADING FINAL group is processed during the chronologically first GENERATE of the report (not at INITIATE, and again after a re-INITIATE), a CH for a control data-name at the beginning of each control group, and on a GENERATE that detects a break the CHs of the break's highest level and every lower level are processed, major to minor; this holds for GENERATE data-name and GENERATE report-name.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.GroupIndicateConsumedByIssuedGenerate (GROUP INDICATE consumption only; not which CHs are processed)
DialectBehavior.ControlFootingPageGroupsSeePriorControlValues (control values a page group sees during a footing phase; not CH selection)
85 refuses the 2002 TYPE CH ... OR PAGE phrase (COBOL0900)

reader.edition-search: grep DialectBehavior|Edition in ReportWriter.cs: four sites (734, 964, 1080, 1490); none sits on the CH selection (the _started first-GENERATE arm presents every CH major to minor; the break arm presents levels breakLevel..last).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: type1.cob printed the identical group trace at --std 85 and --std 2023; 85 only refuses the 2002 OR PAGE phrase

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR4  (3.20.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR4

reader.notes: GenerateCore's first-GENERATE arm presents every CH (SortedDictionary by level, FINAL at 0) and its break arm presents levels breakLevel..last after the footings; DetectBreakLevel skips FINAL. The report file of type1 shows the CH lines in the trace's order across three pages.

refuter.evidence: Probe type4.cob at --std 85: CONTROLS FINAL MAJ MID MIN, a group control area, a page advance mid-report, and six GENERATEs over (A1X)(A1Y)(A2Y)(A2Y)(B2Y)(B2Z). File: PH, CHF, CHA A, CHD 1, CHI X at the first GENERATE; minor break: CFI X then CHI Y only; mid break: CFI Y, CFD 1, CHD 2, CHI Y (MAJ heading not repeated); no break after the page advance; major break: CFI, CFD, CFA A, CHA B, CHD 2, CHI Y. The CHs show the new control values. This matches GR4 and §1985:XIII.4.3.4 GR5c/GR6a3 (major to minor, nothing above the break level). ReportWriter.cs#GenerateCore/DetectBreakLevel consult no edition. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR4 'any control heading report groups associated with the highest control level of the break and lower levels are processed'; OK §1985:XIII.4.3.4 GR6 'Process the control heading report groups in the order major to minor'.
